milestone: Phase 13 - Large-Scale Media Ingestion & Dataset Readiness

phase_14_training_readiness.verdict: PASS (Pipeline Architecture & Audio Recovery Verified); PARTIAL (Corpus Expansion Bounded by YouTube API & Media Access)
evidence_and_findings: FFmpeg pipeline recovered non-silent 16 kHz mono WAV streams for 100% of physical MicroLens media with audio tracks (10 videos).
All 10 recovered audio assets have verified unit-normalized 512-D Wav2Vec2 features persisted.
Synthetic video templates (15 videos) are properly distinguished and recorded with status=FAILED and error_category='NO_AUDIO_STREAM'.
Actual tri-modal aligned count is 10 videos out of target 1000.
Remaining 2958 catalog entries require external YouTube Data API quotas and media download execution.
Production ranking weights remain strictly at zero (w_visual=0.0, w_audio=0.0).
remaining_blockers_for_phase_14: Scale media corpus from 25 to >= 1000 tri-modal aligned videos before initiating supervised multimodal training.
Acquire external YouTube Data API quota and lawful media egress bandwidth for the remaining catalog entries.
Establish leakage-safe train/validation/test splits on the expanded dataset prior to Phase 14 representation training.
